unknown_reasons.auth: Pages show API key encryption types but lack official Binance auth documentation; OAuth, JWT, or other schemes not mentioned in provided pages.
unknown_reasons.access: Public API confirmed free; pages do not specify if authenticated endpoint tier is free, trial, paid-plan-only, or approval-required.
unknown_reasons.api_surface: Pages mention REST and 'Spot' but omit API breadth, OpenAPI spec URL, webhooks, rate-limit details; official Binance documentation not provided.
unknown_reasons.mcp: No official Binance MCP published by vendor; only three third-party community MCP server repos found in pages.
